description: Generates a cryptographically secure random password with specified length and character type requirements (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols). (cost: 1 credit)

include_lowercase.description: boolean, optional, include lowercase letters, no unit, default true

include_numbers.description: boolean, optional, include numeric digits, no unit, default true

include_symbols.description: boolean, optional, include special symbols, no unit, default true

include_uppercase.description: boolean, optional, include uppercase letters, no unit, default true

length.description: integer, required, length of password, characters, no default

name: generate_password
